{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot when price has strong upward momentum, showing lag rather than tracking closely",
    "When sentiment is positive (above 0.5), forecasts are too high by approximately 0.5-1.0 EUR",
    "When sentiment turns negative (below 0.33), forecasts are too low, lagging behind the price correction",
    "Sentiment below 0.33 indicates buyer exhaustion and requires 0.5-1.0 EUR forecast reduction",
    "Model shows mean-reversion bias, underestimating the persistence of price trends",
    "When price has been rising for 5+ consecutive days, forecasts exceed true levels by 0.5-2.0 EUR",
    "Correcting the forecast by averaging with the last 3 days of price eliminates 80%+ of forecast error in these examples"
] }
